title: Exact Bayesian layers via characteristic functions
abstract: arXiv:2611.26426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian neural networks provide principled uncertainty estimates, but training them with Monte Carlo sampling can be expensive. Sampling-free variational inference algorithms make training Bayesian neural networks feasible, but existing approaches assume a Gaussian output distribution, which can be inaccurate in applied problems. Here, we introduce CF-Prop, an uncertainty propagation method that uses characteristic functions to compute the exact output distribution of a Bayesian ReLU layer, without any sampling, even in non-Gaussian settings. Because CF-Prop propagates characteristic functions, the evidence lower bound---the objective of variational training---can be computed in closed form for a broad class of likelihoods, including the Gaussian, Poisson, and Gamma. translated_title: 基于特征函数的精确贝叶斯层
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯神经网络能够提供有原则的不确定性估计，但使用蒙特卡洛采样进行训练的代价可能很高。无采样变分推断算法使训练贝叶斯神经网络变得可行，但现有方法假设输出分布为高斯分布，这在实际应用问题中可能并不准确。本文提出了CF-Prop，一种不确定性传播方法，它利用特征函数来精确计算贝叶斯ReLU层的输出分布，无需任何采样，即使在非高斯情形下同样适用。由于CF-Prop传播的是特征函数，证据下界——变分训练的目标函数——可以对一大类似然函数（包括高斯、泊松和伽马分布）以闭式形式计算。这使得可以实现一种高效的变分推断算法CF-VI。在CIFAR-100上，CF-VI在所有受测方法中取得了最低的校准误差。
tldr: 本文提出CF-Prop方法，利用特征函数无采样地精确计算贝叶斯ReLU层的输出分布（即使在非高斯情形下），并能对高斯、泊松、伽马等多种似然闭式计算证据下界，从而实现高效的变分推断算法CF-VI，在CIFAR-100上取得最低校准误差。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CF-Prop, a sampling-free uncertainty propagation method that uses characteristic functions to exactly compute the output distribution of Bayesian ReLU layers even in non-Gaussian settings, enabling closed-form evidence lower bounds for a broad class of likelihoods and an efficient variational inference algorithm (CF-VI) that achieves the lowest calibration error on CIFAR-100.
